title: Content moderation adapter for new posts
name: Post moderation adapter

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the adapter translates the moderation provider's responses into actions? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The moderation provider times out on a new post. What happens to the post?
choices: It is published, since moderation is best-effort
It is set to pending and enqueued for human review
The error propagates and the post stays in its prior state

questions.prompt: labelThreshold is 0.7 and the provider returns decision ALLOW with categories [{name: 'Spam', confidence: 0.92}]. What does the service do?
choices: Holds the post for review because a label crossed the threshold
Publishes the post with no labels

questions.prompt: The provider responds HTTP 422 because one image URL is not publicly reachable. What happens to the post?
choices: It is published with no labels
The adapter throws and onPostCreated rejects
It is set to pending with label 'moderation_http_422' and queued for review
